services.name: Tennis court
services.desc: Our three pools are surrounded by an acre of lawn with a creek running through the property. The club has a 30 yard pool with a diving area and lap lane, a recreational pool for beginning swimmers, and a wading pool for our youngest members. Children also enjoy swing sets, four-square, and ball games on “the island.” The Pool’s quiet setting lets you leave the cares of the world behind and take a cooling dip. Grills and picnic tables make it a pleasant place for dinner with family and friends. The deck above Vernon Run is a hangout for kids by day and adults in the evening.
